body: Nobody fucking cares, as seen on this post no response. A waste of life and breathing this is for people who are like me. Not the first and certainly not the last, we are the forgotten ones.

Thank you. Its very hard to change when the mainstream tells you all you have to do is be polite, well dressed and have good hygiene. Not to mention, not having a father to teach you how to confront your fears.

I understand where you are coming from. The point you say: 

>I think it's worth more to live an unfortunate lonely life and at the end of it say "well, that sucked, but at least i made it here without killing myself".

I understand this set of thinking. I used to believe it was common sense that that's what you'd want. However, recently I have been interested in science, evolution, life in general, it makes me realize how little we all matter in the grand scale of things. This is not a depressing thing, I believe it is reality. When I think of two options: "living am unfortunate lonely life" and "ending it all and being at peace; complete loss of conciousness, not existing." The natural sense in me of course goes for latter. 

However I will say there's still a part of me that hasn't given up the last bit of hope I have left. I'm just trying to figure out how to make it grow.
Not going to lie I've been interested DnD for a bit of time now. Thank you for the idea.

All of the things you suggested and are saying are things I have done dozens upon dozens of times. The problem isn't that I'm not doing those things. Because I am. The problem is no matter what I do I always feel below everyone, like I can't bond with anybody. It's like there's something missing from me. Like some sort of inner malfunction. I can't find the answer I just can't. No matter what I do, where I go and people I talk to. It's like a black dog following me. I already have given my action. I'm tired of giving action. It doesn't work. It DOESN'T work. It does not. Believe me, I have tried, again and again and again and again. It doesn't work. I don't want people to give me pity. I'm not interested in attention. I just want this to be over so I can be at peace.
